evidence: In view A I represent a yellow circle at the upper location;
My attention is on the yellow circle now; that upper object is also the most recoverable right now.

If I issue any of the available redirection commands in view A, the model predicts my next selection will go to the green triangle at right regardless of which command I choose, so I have little effective control over redistributing attention there.
The triangle at right has almost no current attention and low recoverability.

If I issue any of the available redirection commands in view A, the model predicts my next selection will go to the green triangle at right regardless of which command I choose, so I have little effective control over redistributing attention there.
The blue square and red cross have low attention and intermediate recoverability relative to the others.
